reason: Auditor decision is repair on V3-01. Four must-fix defects remain in the new settlement precondition and replay code: (1) checkMoneyDebtSufficient inverts the counterparty balance sign — valid settlements are rejected, semantically invalid ones accepted; (2) validateSettlementSequence never accumulates appliedSettlements — over-settlement across a sequence is not detected; (3) ledger replay (calculateContributionBalances/calculateFinancialBalances) accepts settlements whose moneyAmountMinor contradicts the snapshotted rate, so replay is not robust against malformed settlements; (4) the new precondition tests encode the inverted semantics and pass for the wrong reasons, masking defects 1-2, and no test covers replay rejection of rate-inconsistent settlements. The baseline zero-sum contribution and expense math is preserved. The coherent delta is retained as WIP baseline for repair.
progressEvidence: npm run check green (typecheck + 42 jest tests, 3 suites)
contribution ledger zero-sum preserved from baseline
expense ledger integer minor-unit math preserved
crossLedgerSettlement structural validation correct (validateCrossLedgerSettlement rejects rate-inconsistent amounts)
period helpers are views-only, never reset perpetual balances
no chrono, Premium, paywall, billing or Firebase types introduced
delta retained as baseline WIP for settlement precondition repair
mustFixFindings: settlementPreconditions.ts: checkMoneyDebtSufficient requires counterparty to owe money (negative balance) but accepted baseline semantics require counterparty to have positive receivable (positive balance); fix: sufficient = counterpartyMoneyBalance >= moneyAmountMinor - 1e-9

settlementPreconditions.ts: validateSettlementSequence pushes appliedSettlements but never reads it; balances always recomputed from raw entries with empty settlements; fix: thread appliedSettlements into balance computation so each subsequent settlement checks remaining balances

contributionLedger.ts validateSettlement + expenseLedger.ts validateSettlementMoney: replay validators check structure only but never verify moneyAmountMinor matches snapshotted rate quote; fix: use validateCrossLedgerSettlement from crossLedgerSettlement.ts in both replay paths

validation-preconditions-periods.test.ts: valid-settlement test uses counterparty with negative balance (wrong semantics); sequence test passes because inverted money check rejects s1 immediately (never exercises accumulation); no replay-rejection test exists; fix: rewrite to accepted baseline scenario (counterparty +1500), genuine accumulation test, and replay rejection test

Preserve the working zero-sum contribution/expense math. Re-run npm run check and verify all 42+ tests pass.
